title: CourtLens refactor branch-base contract (Phase 0 v2)
description: Frozen record of which product commits the CourtLens refactor branch will inherit and which will be excluded. Consumed by future PR 1 (refactor/courtlens-from-legacy) as the authoritative starting point. This v2 revision supersedes the v1 branch/contract that was based directly on main (pre-Gap-3) — see supersedes[] for provenance.
planningBranchHeadNote: The authoritative tip of this planning branch is whatever `git rev-parse docs/courtlens-refactor-phase0-v2` returns on origin. This JSON deliberately does not encode its own commit SHA to avoid a chicken-and-egg amend cycle; the machine-readable branch tip and diff scope live in reports/phase0/scope-report.json which is regenerated on every planning-branch commit.

baseline.rationale: In session on 2026-07-18 the maintainer selected Option A: use the CourtLens Gap-3 product line as the approved current-product baseline, but rebuild it as a clean product-only integration branch that excludes the three evidence-only commits (c7d5318bb, 42f145b4b, f526f9c9b). This planning branch is cut from the integration branch tip so every downstream refactor branch inherits the same product surface without inheriting Gap 3 proof/evidence.

inheritedProductCommits.subject: feat(abr): close CourtLens Gap 3 implementation and proof tooling
inheritedProductCommits.role: Introduces the CourtLens review-packet route, matter-detail server components, i18n messages, and the Gap 3 fixture. Baseline product surface for Phase 1.

inheritedProductCommits.subject: fix(abr): harden CourtLens review-packet audit persistence and proof coverage
inheritedProductCommits.role: Hardens audit-log writes on the CourtLens API surface and adds integration tests for review-packet persistence.

inheritedProductCommits.subject: fix(abr): separate vitest/playwright runners and stabilize audit org resolution
inheritedProductCommits.role: Splits abr test runners so Playwright specs no longer execute inside Vitest, and stabilizes audit organization resolution.

inheritedProductCommits.subject: fix(abr,audit): persist canonical hash timestamp + version for independent recomputation (CourtLens Gap 3)
inheritedProductCommits.role: Adds occurred_at and hash_version columns on audit_events + drizzle migration 0032. Required for independent recomputation of the canonical audit hash chain.

inheritedProductCommits.subject: fix(union-eyes,sage-core): repair pre-existing test failures uncovered during Gap 3 workspace validation
inheritedProductCommits.role: Fixes pre-existing test failures in union-eyes route matrix, insights parser, whitepaper source path, sage-core delivery, and injects a clock into NotificationDispatcher. Orthogonal to CourtLens but required for a green workspace.

inheritedProductCommits.subject: chore(db): regenerate schema snapshot for audit_events.occurred_at + hash_version

excludedEvidenceOnlyCommits.subject: feat(gap3): finalize CourtLens Gap 3 evidence with canonical audit-integrity proof
excludedEvidenceOnlyCommits.reason: Adds only artifacts/courtlens-gap3-final/**, reports/gap3/**, and apps/abr/scripts/gap3/audit-integrity-proof.ts. No product code.

excludedEvidenceOnlyCommits.subject: chore(courtlens/gap3): seal v2 audit-chain evidence + manifest
excludedEvidenceOnlyCommits.reason: Adds only artifacts/courtlens-gap3-final-v2/**, reports/gap3-v2/**, docs/gap3/canonical-audit-hash-v1.md, and apps/abr/scripts/gap3-v2/production-hash-vectors.ts. No product code.

excludedEvidenceOnlyCommits.subject: docs(courtlens/gap3): 21-item closure report v2 (IMPLEMENTED_NOT_PROVEN)
excludedEvidenceOnlyCommits.reason: Single-file docs report. No product code, no schema, no tests.

supersedes.reason: v1 was based on pre-Gap-3 main and bundled three logically-separate changes (Windows lint-staged fix, union-eyes/sage test hardening, CourtLens Phase 0 artifacts). v1 is preserved as forensic reference and MUST NOT be opened as a Phase 0 PR. v1 is superseded by this v2 branch.

companionBranches.purpose: Extracts the Windows lint-staged spawn fix from v1 commit 07fd3fb2e onto main. Independently reviewable prerequisite tooling PR.

maintainerApproval.notes: Maintainer selected Option A (product-only integration branch) in-session on 2026-07-18. Formal signature (approver name, timestamp) must be recorded on the Phase 0 PR before Phase 1 opens. Every entry of docs/courtlens/legacy-inventory-review.json with phase = phase-1 must also have reviewed=true, a reviewer, reviewedAt, notes, and disposition/target set before Phase 1 opens.
